financial_period: STUB / IPO-period report. FP 2025 = financial period from 12 August 2025 (Date of Constitution) to 31 December 2025. The audited P&L covers this partial period; actual property income only from 25 September 2025 (Listing Date) to 31 December 2025. There is no prior-year comparative — comparisons in the report are vs the pro-rated IPO Prospectus forecast. financial_year stamped as 2025 (FY-end 31 Dec 2025).

columns_never_fillable.reason: Accommodation REIT (PBWA/PBSA): size metric is number of beds, not lettable area. No GLA/NLA disclosed anywhere. Land Area (sq m) is captured in gfa as a built/site-area proxy (it is a land area, not lettable area).
Per-property NPI not disclosed. NPI is given only at segment level (Worker 27,797 / Student 8,280 S$'000, Note 30) and by geography %. Per-property disclosure stops at gross rental income.
No per-property tenant lists disclosed. Only a portfolio-wide top-10 tenants table (PBWA corporate tenants) exists; PBSA assets are leased to individual students.
Portfolio Statement gives 'remaining term of lease' (years) not an expiry date; not computed to avoid a fabricated date. effective_date + lease_term_years captured where disclosed.
No single blended portfolio occupancy disclosed; reported by segment (PBWA 97.6%, PBSA 99.1%).
Externally managed REIT; no trust-level employee headcount disclosed. Property opex includes 'reimbursable staff costs' S$3,633k but no headcount.
No FFO/AFFO disclosed. Trust reports 'Amount available/to be distributed to Unitholders' (S$29,995k / S$29,953k) — captured in performance.net_distributable_income. Not equated to net_income.

parsing_traps: Marketing property table (p14-15) gives valuations in LOCAL currency (S$ for SG, GBP for UK, AUD for AU). market_valuation uses the audited Portfolio Statement (p56-57) S$'000 consolidated carrying amounts. Local-currency figures retained in each UK/AU property flag.
Name mismatch: marketing 'Dwell Manchester Student Village' / '...South' = audited 'Dwell MSV' / 'Dwell MSV South'. Matched by location.
Property table gross rental income (p14-15) is in S$'000 for ALL properties (already converted), even where valuation is in local currency.
FX rates (31 Dec 2025): GBP1.00:S$1.7288, A$1.00:S$0.8597 (closing). Purchase-price FX (IPO Prospectus): GBP1.00:S$1.75, A$1.00:S$0.84.
Aggregate leverage: 22.1% actual (year-end) vs 30.7% pro forma (post Jan-2026 Mandai retention + EPIISOD). Used 22.1% actual as the FY2025 figure.
'Total operating expenses S$19.5m' (p27, Property Funds Appendix definition) differs from any single P&L line — it is a regulatory aggregate, not used for standardization.
Borrowings: SFP non-current borrowings S$372,466k = drawn S$376,073k less S$3,607k unamortised transaction costs. total_borrowings headline S$376.1m.

reconciliation.gross_revenue_note: Per-property table 'Gross Rental Income FP 2025' (p14-15) sums: SG 35,963 + UK 11,410 + AU 1,549 = 48,922 S$'000 = 'Rental income from investment properties' (Note 4). Total gross revenue 50,651 = 48,922 rental + 1,729 'Other revenue from accommodation business' (utilities/misc, NOT disclosed per property). So per-property GRI reconciles exactly to the rental line; the 3.4% gate WARN gap is the undistributed 'other accommodation revenue' line — expected, not a missing property.
reconciliation.npi_note: Per-property NPI not disclosed; only segment NPI (Worker 27,797 + Student 8,280 = 36,077 S$'000).
reconciliation.valuation_note: Σ 14 Portfolio Statement carrying amounts (PBWA 1,398,000 + PBSA 486,420) = 1,884,420 S$'000 = total investment properties (SFP Note 19). No JV/equity-accounted assets.
reconciliation.str_reconciliation: Σrevenue (50,742) − Σexpense (28,709) + Σadjustment_signed (-12,338) = 9,695 = net_income = Profit for the period. TIES.
reconciliation.trade_mix_note: Trade_mix is PBWA-Singapore tenant sectors by GRI only (Construction 79 + Marine Shipyard 9 + Engineering 6 + Others 6 = 100%). PBSA (UK/AU, ~26% of revenue) has NO trade-sector mix — students are individuals, disclosed by nationality/study-level instead. So trade_mix is scoped to the PBWA segment, not portfolio-wide.

inferred.basis: Construction & Engineering -> Infrastructure, Real Estate & Property Services; Marine Shipyard -> Manufacturing; Others -> Other Industrial Trades. Verbatim labels kept in category_raw.
sector column on p18 (Construction/Engineering -> Infrastructure RE & Property Services; Marine Shipyard -> Manufacturing) mapped to canonical 15.
